# `md_table`

GitHub-flavoured Markdown tables, for READMEs and pull request descriptions.

Usage: `from textkit.formats.md_table import render`

Sample output:

```
| sku | name | qty |
|---|---|---|
| W-1 | Widget | 3 |
| G-2 | Gadget, large |  |
```
